title: Verify LR-FHSS waveform and RX direction claims
description:
Build a primary-source inventory of exact waveform, device, firmware and direction capabilities. Distinguish ordinary LoRa RX/TX, LR-FHSS transmission and actual LR-FHSS reception. Include the dated Semtech SX1302 clarification and investigate any newer receiver claims on their own evidence.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Read-only primary-source research. Do not purchase equipment, contact vendors or modify capability negotiation. Existing project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.78 owns the integration gap; this task supplies feasibility evidence rather than duplicating its implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Each claimed receive path identifies actual demodulation hardware/software and supported waveform revision. GMSK LR-FHSS is not treated as narrow CSS; an SX1302/SX1303 name or endpoint capability flag is not RX proof. Unverified or obsolete claims remain explicitly classified.
